items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Jane Seskin came by and she was doing this book and so I sat down with her for a couple sessions

ctx.x: Would you like to give the title and the author's name?
Yeah, the title of the book is 'More Than Mere Survival' and Jane Seskin is the authoress and it's conversations with women over 65.
It just appeared this year, 1980 and it's published by Newsweek.
